shortDescription: As of September 15, gas storage facilities in Poland were 98% full, Gas Storage Poland said in a statement on Wednesday."At the end of the day on September 15, approximately 36.2 TWh of natural gas was held in storage, corresponding to about 3.3 billion cubic meters of gas fuel," the company said.
